 S.G.MAJMUDAR FOOD INSPECTOR  Versus  KHOJAMBHAI ABDAALI MOTIWALA ================================================================
Appearance:
MS NEHA LODHA FOR MR KI SHAH(766) for the PETITIONER(s) No. 1 DELETED(20) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 2 KSHITIJ M AMIN(7572) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 1 MR KL PANDYA ADDITIONAL PUBLIC PROSECUTOR for the Respondent9s) No.3 ================================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE G.R.UDHWANI  Date : 11/04/2018  ORAL JUDGMENT S.G.Majmudar Food Inspector vs Khojambhai Abdaali Motiwala on 11 April, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58607110/
1 1 . J u d g e m e n t a n d o r d e r d a t e d 0 1 .

1 0 . 2 0 0 1 p a s s e d b y t h e J u d i c i a l  Magistrate First Class, Municipal Court, Surat recording acquittal for the respondent no.1 for the  o f f e n c e p u n i s h a b l e u n d e r t h e P r e v e n t i o n o f  F o o d A d u l t e r a t i o n A c t i n P . F . A C a s e N o . 2 7 o f 1 9 9 9 i s a s s a i l e d i n t h i s  appeal under section 378 of the Code of Criminal Procedure ( for short R/CR.A/2017/2006 JUDGMENT 'Cr.P.C').
2.

Having considered the submission made by the learned counsel for the appellant, it  t r a n s p i r e s t h a t o n e o f t h e g r o u n d f o r a c q u i t t a l  r e c o r d e d b y t h e c o u r t w a s t h e l a c k o f e v i d e n c e t o i d e n t i f y r e s p o n d e n t  n o .
1 a s t h e p r o p r i e t o r o r o w n e r o f t h e s h o p w h e r e f r o m t h e s a m p l e o f  chickpea for analysis was taken.

The court below has found that despite giving full opportunity  t o t h e a p p e l l a n t t o e s t a b l i s h t h e s a i d f a c t , t h e  e v i d e n c e d e f i c i e n t i n m a t e r i a l p a r t i c u l a r w a s t e n d e r e d t o t h e c o u r t . I n t h e  d o c u m e n t s p r o d u c e d i . e . E x h .
2 4 - a n i n t i m a t i o n l e t t e r , o n l y n a m e o f t h e
p e r s o n w a s m e n t i o n e d w i t h o u t m e n t i o n i n g t h e n a m e o f t h e s h o p a n d i n  Exh.
25 also, the name of the concerned person or its proprietor was lacking.
Even in  memorandum, such details were lacking.
No other evidence was adduced to establish  that respondent no. 1 was the owner and respondent no.2 was the salesman o f " t h e s p o t " .
T h u s i n a b s e n c e o f s u c h a n e v i d e n c e , s u c h p e r s o n s c o u l d
n o t h a v e b e e n t r i e d a s a c c u s e d a n d w e r e r i g h t l y a c q u i t t e d b y t h e c o u r t  b e l o w .
T h i s c o u r t d o e s n o t f i n d a n y r e a s o n t o i n t e r f e r e i n t h e a p p e a l  recording acquittal, under section 378 of Cr.P.C.
The appeal fails and is dismissed.
3. Record and Proceedings if any shall be returned to the Court below.

(G.R.UDHWANI, J) niru*
